title: 第14章 目标玄甲卫第15章 感悟铁甲拳
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
张全武和陈梁，还有一旁的李长卫都将目光投向孙泽。
孙泽沉默片刻，摇摇头：“张振当初是参加镇抚司特殊任务，哪些人参加，处理什么事情，都是外人所不可知。”
特殊任务。
镇抚司中其实有不少的任务都是如此。
这种任务参与者需要保密，外人也不能轻易打探。
“这三个月来我们查了许多地方，甚至去了外府几个可能有关联之地。”
“镇抚司中私下打听过，都没有线索。”
孙泽面上露出几分颓唐。
或许，这就是张远问他大哥张振怎么死的时候，他会发怒的原因。
他真的无能为力。
张远点点头。
他此时已经真正的冷静下来。
镇抚司涉及秘密任务的，从来都不是寻常武者能应对。
像白马山匪寇那样震动府城的案件，当初都没有下发秘密任务。
“秘密任务，基本上都是跟司狱二层甚至三层之中的囚犯有关。”张全武嘴角哆嗦一下，压低声音，“我三年前曾参加过一次秘密任务。”
这事情本是不能说的。
只是今日在场都是自己人，他看着张远他们，面皮微微抽动：“杀妖，一头狼妖。”
“那是我真正见到什么是，妖……”
张全武的目中透出恐惧，手脚微微颤抖：“三十位皂衣卫兄弟，活着回来的只有八位。”
车厢之中，再次沉默。

张远握紧拳头，呼吸有些凝重。
秘密任务，可能任务已经完成，仇怨已经无需去报了。
又或者，这仇怨根本无力去报。
张远微微咬牙，还是不甘心就这么放弃知道大哥殉职的真相。
便是妖，又如何？
“如果你能成为都尉营首，可以翻阅典籍司中关于出任务的记录，自然就能找到你大哥当初殉职的关联任务。”
孙泽看向张远，摇摇头：“我老了，等你军功攒够，我就会将旗官的位置让出来。”
“你已经入了几位上官的眼，好好干，有机会的。”
成为都尉，执掌一营？
就算是顺风顺水，积攒军功恐怕也需要很多年吧？
仙秦军功，三级一功，三功一转，三转一阶。
顾名思义，斩三敌首级方为一个军功，三功才有资格提升军职，真正要想成为上一个层次需要三转。
要从皂衣卫升任旗官，需要三转，也就是九功，二十七级。
再从旗官到都尉，再是三转，可就是二十七功，近百级才有机会晋升。
正是因为军功难得，晋升极难，才有军职世袭之法。
张远不知道自己一个小小的玄衣卫，想积攒百级军功至都尉，需要多少年。
哪怕自己通过杀人能快速提升修为，可军功是要实打实积攒的。
“头，还有没有其他办法？”张远深吸一口气，低着头，声音好似被什么堵住。
如果自己没有杀人提升修为的隐秘，没有已经开启的先天真元，张远或许会将所有的心思压下，按照孙泽所说的，积攒功勋。
可现在的自己，怎么甘心？

孙泽目光盯着张远，沉吟片刻，压低声音：“张远，你告诉我，你现在是什么修为？”
修为。
孙泽的话让张全武和陈梁他们都抬头。
content_en:
Zhang Quanwu, Chen Liang, and Li Changwei all turned their attention to Sun Ze.
Sun Ze was silent for a moment and shook his head: "Zhang Zhen originally participated in the special mission of the Zhenfu Division. Who participated and what matters were handled are unknown to outsiders."
Special tasks.
In fact, many tasks in the Zhenfu Division are like this.
Participants in such tasks need to be kept secret, and outsiders cannot easily pry.
"In the past three months, we have checked many places, and even went to several places in Waifu that may be related."
"I have inquired privately in the Zhenfu Division, but there are no clues."
Sun Ze's face showed a bit of despair.
Perhaps this is why Zhang Yuan got angry when he asked his elder brother Zhang Zhen why he died.
There's really nothing he can do.
Zhang Yuan nodded.
He had truly calmed down at this time.
The secret missions involved in the Zhenfu Division are never something ordinary warriors can handle.
Cases like the Baima Mountain bandits that shocked the city were not assigned secret missions at the beginning.
"Secret missions are basically related to the prisoners on the second or even third floor of the prison." Zhang Quanwu trembled at the corner of his mouth and lowered his voice, "I participated in a secret mission three years ago."
This thing cannot be said.
But today, all of them are his own people. He looked at Zhang Yuan and the others, his face twitching slightly: "Kill the demon, a wolf demon."
"That's what I really saw, the demon..."
Zhang Quanwu's eyes showed fear, and his hands and feet trembled slightly: "Of the thirty Zaoyi Guard brothers, only eight came back alive."
There was silence in the carriage again.
Zhang Yuan clenched his fists and breathed heavily.
The secret mission, maybe the mission has been completed, and there is no need to avenge the grudge.
Or perhaps, there is no way to avenge this grudge.
Zhang Yuan gritted his teeth slightly, still unwilling to give up on knowing the truth about his elder brother's death.
It's a demon, so what?
"If you can become the commander of the Captain's Battalion, you can read the mission records in the Classics Department, and you will naturally be able to find the related missions in which your eldest brother died in the line of duty."
Sun Ze looked at Zhang Yuan and shook his head: "I'm old. When you have enough military exploits, I will give up the position of flag officer."
"You have caught the eye of several superiors. Work hard and you will have a chance."
Become a captain and take charge of a battalion?
Even if things go smoothly, it will probably take many years to accumulate military merit, right?
Immortal Qin's military merits are three levels and one level, three levels and one level.
As the name suggests, beheading three enemies is a military merit. Only with three merits can one be qualified to be promoted to military rank. To truly reach the next level, one needs three transfers.
To be promoted from Zaoyi Guard to Flag Officer, one needs three rounds, which is nine skills, twenty-seven levels.
From flag officer to captain, and then to the third rank, it takes twenty-seven skills and nearly a hundred levels to have a chance to be promoted.
It is precisely because military merit is rare and promotion is extremely difficult that military positions are hereditary.
Zhang Yuan didn't know how many years it would take for him, a small Xuanyi guard, to accumulate 100-level military merit and become a captain.
Even if you can quickly improve your cultivation by killing people, military merit must be accumulated in earnest.
"Boss, is there any other way?" Zhang Yuan took a deep breath, lowered his head, and his voice seemed to be blocked by something.
If he didn't have the secret to kill people to improve his cultivation, and if he didn't have the innate true essence that had been opened, Zhang Yuan might suppress all his thoughts and accumulate merit as Sun Ze said.
But how can I be willing to do this now?
Sun Ze stared at Zhang Yuan, pondered for a moment, and lowered his voice: "Zhang Yuan, tell me, what is your current level of cultivation?"
Cultivation.
Sun Ze's words made Zhang Quanwu and Chen Liang raise their heads.
